Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies data science expertise at scale. We are looking for knowledgeable data scientists based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered data science solutions. agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.title: Investment Banking Winter Analyst - Infrastructure M&A Advisory - Winter 2027
agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.description: Our Firm Agentis Capital Advisors is a leading global financial advisor with a reputation for delivering unparalleled value and advice to its clients. The firm has been the recipient of numerous industry rewards in recent years, including 2024 P3 Awards Financial Advisor of the Year. Our guiding principles and ability to generate value for clients sets us apart. Agentis acts as a sell-side and buy-side advisor on a wide variety of global transactions including renewable power, energy, digital, transportation, and public-private partnerships. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, contractors, and governments. Agentis Capital Advisors is a business segment of Agentis Capital Partners, which operates a synergistic platform across four main business segments: Agentis Capital Partners (principal investments), Agentis Capital Advisors (financial advisory and asset management services), Agentis Capital Mining Partners (mining advisory), and Agentis Capital Markets (capital markets). The Opportunity The intern program includes a formal program of instruction in project finance, financial statement analysis, and financial modeling. Analyst interns are expected to demonstrate financial modeling capabilities through real-world applications and will be invited to work on active projects. You will be recognized and rewarded for your individual performance within a close-knit team and meritocratic culture. Upon successful completion of the internship, interns have the opportunity to be invited back to join Agentis in a full-time position. Your Contribution As an analyst intern, you can expect to be challenged from day one by complex, high-pressure assignments that will directly impact our clients and the firm. As a member of our advisory team, you will work closely in groups led by senior partners and will have exposure to a wide variety of transactions within a performance-based culture. Your role will include: - Participating in the execution of equity and debt offerings, mergers and acquisitions, public-private partnerships, and principal investments - Assisting in the development of complex financial models for infrastructure transactions, including the use of macros and VBA programming - Assisting in the management of due diligence processes, including managing third-party advisors - Developing asset valuations using a variety of approaches - Preparing client presentations and participating in discussions - Assisting the senior team in the evaluation of investment opportunities and management of existing investments - Researching potential investment banking opportunities; providing research on target companies, sectors, industries, and geographies - Maintaining marketing materials for the firm, including creating pitch decks to be presented to potential clients. - As a member of a high-performing team working in a fast-paced environment, there will be times where you will be required to work beyond a normal workday or workweek to fulfill the responsibilities of the role. Our Differentiators - Competitive compensation packages - Direct exposure to senior team members and industry leaders - Incredible opportunities for career growth including analyst track - Opportunities to work on projects with one of Agentis’ portfolio companies in other sectors including consulting, healthcare, fintech, and agriculture - Participation in Agentis’ internal training modules including a leadership development program - Regular team events - Potential to be invited back for a full-time position Your Skills and Experience - An undergraduate degree in accounting, finance, commerce, business, statistics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or other related areas - Graduating by Summer/Fall 2027 - Exceptional academic results (minimum cGPA of 80% or 3.7/4.0) - Ability to concisely communicate complex concepts and ideas verbally and in writing - Ability to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision - De

cagents-cagents:lever:cc226e00-f733-4a64.title: Reliability Field Engineer
cagents-cagents:lever:cc226e00-f733-4a64.description: Position Description: As a Reliability Field Engineer, you are an integral part of our Operational Readiness team. You will coordinate, prepare, review and research equipment and material databases that allow out teams to recommend the best maintenance and asset management practices for our clients. If you enjoy hands-on experience while building your foundation of maintenance and reliability skillsets, this position is for you. Requirements include: Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Perform field walk-downs of systems and processes to collect or validate baseline equipment specification data Refine and load equipment information and engineering specifications into a database to achieve standardized records Collaborate with equipment manufacturers and vendors to develop unique parts lists Review maintenance data, engineering drawings, technical manuals, and other documentation to communicate associated reliability findings and recommendations Draft Failure Mode and Effect Analysis sheets (FMEA) on systems and equipment Perform all necessary quality control functions that are required to ensure that complete, accurate, and relevant data is provided to the customer Position Requirements: BS in an Engineering or Science field or equivalent experience 2+ years’ experience in process engineering, maintenance, and reliability or operational excellence, lean six sigma and TPM Ability to read Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID) Ability to identify industrial equipment and record data in spreadsheets Ability to perform work with frequent interruptions and distractions. Ability to accomplish tasks by focusing on all areas involved; ensuring all associated processes and tasks are completed and accurate. Ability to effectively operate computer tablet and PC technology and software. Ability to interact and collaborate with others, both in person and through phone, e-mail, and written correspondence. Other Requirements: Excellent oral and written English is required Able to travel domestically and internationally if required Able to work (paid) overtime Able to work in the US without sponsorship now or any time or in the future About CAI CAI, established in 1996, has grown to more than 800 people worldwide. We provide commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, project management and other consulting services associated with operational readiness to FDA regulated and other mission-critical industries. Are You Ready? Our approach is simple; we put the client’s interests first, we do not stop until it is right, and we will do whatever it takes to get there. As owners of CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally: We act with integrity. We serve each other. We serve society. We work for our future. With employee ownership, one person’s success is everyone’s success; we work diligently to accomplish team goals. We place Team Before Self, demonstrate Respect for Others, and possess a Can-Do Attitude (our core values). That is how we have grown exponentially. Benefits Our full-time positions offer competitive compensation and benefits which include: up to 4% retirement contribution, 24 days PTO and 5 sick days per year, health insurance at extremely low cost to employee, financial support for both internal and external professional education as well as 70% long term disability paid for by the company. #LI-MV1

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c9abd909-8382-.title: Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c9abd909-8382-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager based in Switzerland. This is a commercially focused role for a digital marketing professional who can turn online visibility into measurable revenue growth. You’ll own strategies across SEO, AEO, GEO, paid advertising, email marketing, landing pages, and e-commerce optimisation. Your focus will be on generating qualified B2B leads, increasing online sales, and strengthening customer acquisition and retention. You’ll work across diverse customer segments and extensive product catalogues, connecting marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution, experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimisation. It’s an ideal opportunity for an analytical, results-driven professional who wants their work measured by revenue, conversions, and sustainable business growth. Develop and execute an inbound marketing strategy focused on generating qualified B2B enquiries, quote requests, bulk orders, reseller opportunities, account applications, and online sales. Build targeted campaigns and lead-generation funnels for different industries, customer segments, product categories, and purchasing needs. Partner with sales and management teams to track leads from initial enquiry through conversion, improve lead quality, and introduce lead scoring, automated follow-up, and nurturing workflows. Own the organic search strategy across SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation, and Generative Engine Optimisation, including keyword research, competitor analysis, technical optimisation, structured data, internal linking, content architecture, and search-intent analysis. Optimise product, category, service, and location-based pages to improve rankings and visibility across traditional search engines and AI-generated search results. Develop commercially focused content around pricing, bulk purchasing, product comparisons, specifications, delivery information, and frequently asked questions. Create and optimise high-converting landing pages for retail, wholesale, reseller, corporate, and government audiences. Improve calls to action, forms, account applications, checkout journeys, and other conversion points through testing and behavioural analysis. Manage and optimise the e-commerce platform, including product information, descriptions, specifications, imagery, category structures, pricing, stock information, promotions, and customer journeys. Develop strategies to increase average order value, purchase frequency, and repeat revenue through bundles, volume offers, cross-selling, upselling, promotions, and abandoned-cart recovery. Plan, launch, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, remarketing, display, and relevant Meta or LinkedIn channels. Manage advertising budgets and continuously improve cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on advertising spend. Build segmented email marketing and automated lifecycle campaigns covering new enquiries, quote follow-ups, abandoned carts, account applications, repeat-order reminders, customer reactivation, product launches, and promotions. Analyse campaign, CRM, website, and sales data to identify which marketing activities generate customers and revenue rather than relying on vanity metrics. Build and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards covering leads, quote requests, e-commerce sales, conversion rates, organic performance, advertising efficiency, average order value, repeat purchasing, and marketing-attributed revenue. Identify priority products, customer segments, and growth opportunities in collaboration with sales and management teams. Continuously test, measure, and refine marketing initiatives to improve commercial performance and establish clear attribution between digital activity and revenue. R

labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:06b8da6b-7b4f-.title: AI Engineer Tools & Automations
labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:06b8da6b-7b4f-.description: Labhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products — including Invoice Fly and Summary AI — are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first. We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. THE ROLE At Labhouse, AI isn't just what we ship to users — it's how we operate internally. As our AI Engineer, you'll design and build LLM-powered tools, agents, and automations that remove friction and unlock speed across the company. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will: - Identify manual, repetitive, or slow processes and turn them into AI-powered tools and automations - Design and build LLM-based agents that can reason, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks autonomously - Own projects end-to-end — from scoping the problem and understanding the business need, to designing, building, and shipping the solution - Integrate LLMs and agents with internal systems and third-party tools - Work directly with team leads to understand where AI can unlock the most impact — and translate that into working products - Measure the productivity and efficiency gains your work generates, and iterate based on real usage ABOUT YOU Academic Background We care more about what you've built than where you studied. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is a plus, but relevant hands-on experience matters more than the diploma. What We Are Looking For You've already done this before — you've walked into a company, spotted where AI could solve a real problem, and built the solution yourself, end to end. You're not looking for your first shot at this. - Strong, proven experience working with LLMs in production — prompting, fine-tuning, RAG, or agent-based systems - Deep knowledge of agent frameworks and how to design multi-step, tool-using workflows - Track record of shipping tools or automations that measurably improved productivity or performance in a company - Strong Python skills and comfort integrating APIs, webhooks, and third-party tools - Business vision — you understand how a company operates and can spot high-leverage opportunities for automation without being told where to look - Comfortable working in fast-moving, data-heavy environments where speed and iteration matter - Experience building tools or automations involving paid or organic acquisition data (campaigns, channels, attribution, or similar) is a strong plus - Ability to work autonomously, prioritize based on impact, and ship without waiting for perfect conditions AI Proficiency You live and breathe AI tools — not just LLM APIs, but the broader ecosystem of agents, copilots, and automation platforms. You stay on top of the state of the art and know how to turn new capabilities into practical, working tools fast. Communication You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You know how to interview a team about their pain points, translate that into a technical solution, and explain the result in terms they care about. Nice to Have - Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) - Experience with automation/workflow platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make) - Experience building tools involving data pipelines, dashboards, or reporting systems - Prior experience in a startup or fast-moving, resource-constrained environment WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive compensation package - Hybrid work model based in Barcelona - High ownership from day one — you define the direction, not just execut

s2ginvestments-earthoptics:bamboohr:368.title: Soil Chemistry / ICP Instrumentation Consultant
s2ginvestments-earthoptics:bamboohr:368.description: Join EarthOptics as the Soil Chemistry / ICP Instrumentation Consultant ! Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost-effectively increase yields and improve soil health and the climate. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. At EarthOptics, we are combining cutting-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. Our unified mission is to help farmers and ranchers sustainably increase their yields and feed the growing world through all things soil. We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have ~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world see soil differently. EarthOptics is seeking an experienced Soil Chemistry / ICP Instrumentation Consultant to support high-throughput soil chemistry operations in our Emeryville, CA lab. This part-time contractor will provide hands-on support and guidance for development of QA/QC protocols, QA/QC review, instrument troubleshooting, and practical workflow improvement. The ideal consultant has direct experience operating ICP-OES and/or ICP-MS instruments in a soil, agricultural, environmental, or analytical chemistry lab. This person should be comfortable with calibration, standards, blanks, duplicates, spikes, rerun criteria, contamination control, instrument maintenance, method development, and review of analytical data for quality and consistency. This is a hands-on technical role. The consultant will work closely with Soil Science Lab Operations, and Data teams to support reliable data generation, reduce instrument downtime, and improve ICP-related workflows. The digs: Job Type: Independent Contractor, approximately 1-2 days per week. Initial engagement may be structured as a 3- to 6-month contract, with possible extension based on lab needs. Target Start Date: ASAP Compensation: $1,000-$1,500/day, depending on experience Responsibilities Include: Troubleshoot ICP-OES and/or ICP-MS instrumentation used for high-throughput soil chemistry analysis. Review analytical data for quality assurance and quality control, including instrument drift, contamination, calibration performance, failed controls, rerun criteria, and overall data integrity. Document instrument issues, maintenance activities, QC findings, corrective actions, and quality findings. Improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), laboratory workflows, quality control processes, and operator consistency. Recommend practical improvements that increase instrument reliability, laboratory throughput, and analytical data quality. Collaborate closely with Soil Science and Data teams to ensure accurate, timely, and reliable soil chemistry results. Operates with EarthOptics’ cultural concepts of Autonomy, Accountability, Collaboration, Customer Centricity, Grit, and Grace. Are you our soil-mate?: (Your qualifications) Bachelor's degree in Soil Science, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Agronomy, or a related scientific discipline. Hands-on experience with ICP-OES and/or ICP-MS operation. Experience troubleshooting instrumentation, analytical methods, sample preparation, and laboratory data quality issues. Experience with soil, agricultural, environmental, plant, water, or comparable sample matrices. Strong understanding of analytical quality assurance and quality control practices. Strong technical documentation and written/verbal communication skills. High-throughput production lab experience. Soil nutrient or elemental analysis experience. Experience with LIMS, instrument data systems, SQL, Python, R, or structured data review. I nclusion and Diversity at EarthOptics: At EarthOptics,
